title: Furnishing Information on Pendency of Cases

content.scenario: The State Government requested the State Commission to provide information on the pendency of cases, including the number of cases pending and the time taken to dispose of them. The State Commission provided the information in a format different from what was prescribed.
content.outcome: The State Commission is obligated to furnish information, including pendency of cases, to the State Government periodically or as and when required, in the prescribed form and manner. The Commission's failure to follow the prescribed format may be considered a violation of the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What information is the State Commission required to furnish to the State Government?
In what format and manner should the State Commission provide information?
Can the State Commission refuse to provide information to the State Government?
